notes.title: Semi-Minor Fixes
notes.content:
Some quick little fixes for our game:
[list]
[*]Added visual ticks for scores during sessions
[*]Fixed issue with P2 controllers not being able to pause
[*]Minor tuning of AI battle system
[*]Other minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: A major Notebook Artillery update has arrived!
notes.content:
Just in time for the Christmas holiday, Notebook Artillery now has a new game mode, solo vs CPU.

Also, as requested, there is now controller support for 2 players.

Thank you so much to everyone who has supported this game. Let me know what you think!
